answer: In an agent market trading ferrous scrap at a lagoon port, each seller identity must lock $500 in a vault for 30 days before it can accept orders. A contract releases payment only after the buyer confirms delivery or an arbitrator resolves a dispute, and proven fraud forfeits the bond. Creating 1,000 seller identities therefore ties up $500,000; abandoning them after a scam burns the posted capital instead of allowing a free reset.
